cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a high position with the gripper pointing upwards and performs a series of lateral oscillations to mimic a friendly greeting.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot arm quickly ascends to a high position with the gripper pointing upwards to signal acknowledgement, performs a subtle double wrist rotation to mimic a wave, and then smoothly descends to a neutral resting posture.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot arm simulates a formal bow by starting from a neutral height, arching forward and downward, holding a respectful pause at the lowest point, and then slowly returning to an upright posture.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot prepares its gripper in a vertical orientation and extends its arm forward toward the user at a natural height, holding the pose to invite a social interaction.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper in a vertical orientation to mimic a hand-offering pose, then performs a series of rhythmic up-and-down movements at the elbow to simulate a handshake.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot arm moves from an open, receptive position and sweeps inward across the chest to simulate a self-embracing gesture. It holds the position with a gentle pulsing 'squeeze' to convey a sense of comfort or self-soothing before releasing back to neutral.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot simulates blowing a kiss by bringing the gripper close to its 'face' area with the tip pointing inward, pausing briefly, then extending the arm forward while flicking the wrist upward as if releasing the kiss into the air.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot reaches high above its head and traces a large, continuous heart shape in the air to express affection or love, starting from the center notch, sweeping through the lobes, and meeting at the bottom point.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot moves its hand toward the center of its torso with the gripper pointing inward, holding the position to convey a sense of sincerity, heartfelt gratitude, or self-reference.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot arm prepares by retracting to a lower central position with the gripper pointing up. It then performs a powerful, rapid upward thrust to a high extension, holding the peak position briefly before executing a series of quick celebratory shakes to signal victory and excitement.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot arm raises to a high position and performs two sharp, forceful downward pumping motions with the wrist oriented vertically, signifying a celebratory 'Yes!' or success.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot moves its arm into a classic bodybuilding pose by raising the elbow to the side and curling the forearm toward the shoulder. It holds the flexed position with a slight 'squeeze' pulse to emphasize strength before returning to neutral.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot mimics a nodding gesture by tilting its gripper up and down from the wrist multiple times to signal agreement, affirmation, or a 'yes' response.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot mimics a human 'no' gesture by positioning the gripper forward at head-height and performing a rapid side-to-side rotation of the wrist.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot mimics a human shrug by quickly raising the arm to a high position while orienting the gripper tip upward and flat to represent open palms, holding the pose to convey uncertainty, and then returning to a neutral state.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot arm reaches up towards the side of its head area, performs several quick, small-scale scratching motions with its wrist, and then pauses in a contemplative posture to signal confusion.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot positions its gripper at eye level facing forward, then slowly tilts the 'head' (wrist) to the side and holds the position to simulate a questioning or curious gaze.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot arm moves quickly to position its gripper directly in front of its face area, signaling frustration, embarrassment, or disbelief. It holds the position briefly with a slight dejected wrist tilt to emphasize the emotion.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot moves its arm to a central position, orienting the gripper tip toward its own body to signal 'me' or 'myself', followed by two subtle tapping motions towards the chest.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot extends its arm directly forward to point at an object or person, holding the position with a brief, assertive double-motion to clarify the target.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm toward the viewer with the gripper oriented horizontally to represent a downward-facing palm. It then executes a repetitive beckoning motion by curling the wrist upward and inward toward its body.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm and extends it directly forward with the gripper pointing upward, simulating a palm-forward 'stop' gesture that is held firmly.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot quickly raises its forearm and points the gripper tip straight up, holding the position to signal a pause or emphasize an important statement.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot raises its gripper to its face level, centering it close to the body. The gripper is oriented vertically and pointed upwards to represent an index finger, then held still to signal for silence.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot moves its gripper to a position directly in front of its torso, oriented horizontally and pointing toward itself. It then performs a rhythmic patting motion by rotating the elbow to move the gripper toward and away from the body.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot arm reaches across its torso to the opposite shoulder and performs a rapid, shivering rubbing motion along the upper arm to signal it is cold.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises its arm to face level with the gripper oriented vertically, then performs a rapid, repetitive fanning motion to signal that it is hot.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot simulates a yawn by stretching its arm upward to represent the peak of a yawn, then quickly brings its gripper back to its face area to cover its 'mouth' in a polite, sleepy gesture.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot arm raises the gripper to the side of its head near the eye level, then performs a gentle back-and-forth rubbing motion with the wrist to signal sleepiness or fatigue.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot positions its arms at its sides with the grippers pointing down, then executes a slow, deep forward lean from the shoulder to simulate a formal Japanese-style bow of apology, holding the lowered position before slowly returning to upright.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot raises its arm to a high position with the gripper pointing upward to simulate a hand next to the head, then performs two rapid downward-and-upward wrist tilts to mimic the 'air quotes' finger gesture.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot arm moves the gripper to the side of its head (temple height) and performs a double-tap motion by rotating the wrist, signaling a clever idea or the act of thinking.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, traces multiple small circles with its wrist to signal 'crazy' or 'thinking too hard', and then lowers the arm to a neutral position.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot arm moves the gripper to the 'mouth' area, positioning it vertically as if holding a zipper, then performs a swift horizontal slide across the face followed by a small wrist flick to 'lock' the motion.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position across its torso to a tight, high-inward position, holding the pose to simulate a defensive or closed-off posture.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot arm moves to a lateral position and plants the gripper against its side. The gripper tip points back toward the torso to mimic a hand-on-hip stance, followed by a sharp elbow and shoulder adjustment that simulates an assertive flare of confidence or an annoyed huff.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot arm moves forward and tilts the gripper into an open, horizontal position to mimic a human 'interest' posture, leaning toward the subject to show engagement.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot quickly retracts its arm toward its body while raising the gripper into a vertical 'stop' position, held at a high chest level to mimic a startled human reaction.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot quickly brings its gripper up to its facial area with the palm facing inward, creating a startled 'gasp' or 'oops' gesture, followed by a slight nervous tremor.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot moves its arm to a central chest-high position with the gripper pointing upwards and oriented vertically to simulate palms pressed together. It then performs a controlled forward tilt of the upper arm segments to mimic a respectful bow.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot arm mimics a celebratory toast by raising the gripper vertically to eye level, extending it forward, performing a subtle forward tilt to 'clink' the glass, and then returning to a neutral pose.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot arm extends forward and upward, orienting the gripper tip toward the ceiling with the palm facing the user to signal a high-five invitation.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot raises its arm to a high, forward position with the gripper pointing up to simulate a ready palm, then performs a sharp downward swing of the elbow to mimic the impact of a high-five.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot arm moves from a retracted position to an extended forward pose. The gripper is held in a vertical orientation to mimic a fist, reaching out toward the user and holding the position to invite a fist bump.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot prepares its gripper in a vertical orientation to mimic a fist and positions itself at a mid-range height and depth. It then performs a rhythmic, two-part tapping motion forward as if making contact with a palm held in front of it, before retracting slightly to a resting position.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot reaches its arm up and backward toward its own shoulder, then executes a series of gentle tapping motions with the wrist to simulate a self-congratulatory pat on the back.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot extends its arm forward to a pointing posture and traces two complete circles in the air using the wrist joint, signaling a repetitive cycle or circular motion.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot positions its gripper horizontally near its neck on one side, then executes a rapid, sharp horizontal traversal to the opposite side to signal an immediate stop or 'cut' command, holding the final position briefly for emphasis.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot brings its gripper close to its 'chin' area with the tip pointing back toward the body, then performs a sharp, high-speed outward flick of the wrist and elbow to mimic a dismissive 'get lost' or 'whatever' gesture.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot positions its hand palm-down near a surface and performs rapid, repetitive tapping motions with the wrist to simulate drumming fingers while waiting or feeling bored.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper oriented horizontally to simulate an open palm facing upward. It then performs a repetitive beckoning motion by tilting the wrist upward and returning it to the start, signaling a request for an item.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot transitions its gripper to a palm-up position and slowly extends its arm forward and slightly upward, mimicking the gesture of offering an item or presenting something to a person.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to a high, lateral position with the gripper pointing upwards and the opening facing forward. It performs a small, shaky oscillation at the wrist to emphasize the 'surrender' gesture before holding the pose.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot moves its gripper to the side of its head in a vertical orientation to block sound, performs a quick pressing motion with a distressed jitter, and then repeats the gesture on the opposite side to signal that it is covering both ears.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot moves its arm from a neutral central position into a wide, expansive outward arc to mimic a welcoming embrace, signaling openness and greeting.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot performs an expansive upward reaching motion to simulate a satisfying stretch. It starts from a mid-height position, extends the arm to its maximum vertical height with a slight tension-induced tremble, and holds the peak for a moment of relief before slowly relaxing.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot arm moves swiftly from a resting position to the temple, orienting the gripper horizontally to mimic a formal military salute, holds the position with a sharp snap, and then returns to neutral.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot arm raises its gripper horizontally above its head level to form a protective visor. It then performs a deliberate side-to-side scanning motion to simulate searching the horizon before returning to a resting position.
